purpose: A searchable, interest-tagged snapshot of upcoming public Hartford events, with an append-only archive of previously collected event records.

feeds_collected.name: Hartford Public Library
feeds_collected.coverage: Library branch programs, with event dates, locations, event tags, audience and registration details where available.

feeds_collected.name: Hartford.com
feeds_collected.coverage: Selected current downtown and citywide event listings. Click through for details and cost.

feeds_collected.name: Eventbrite Hartford search
feeds_collected.coverage: Hartford-located public listings returned by the search page at refresh time. This is not the complete Eventbrite catalog.

additional_live_calendars.name: City of Hartford events
additional_live_calendars.coverage: Live city calendar with a Free filter; linked in the app for events not collected into the snapshot.

limitations: No single feed covers every Hartford event. Listings may be missing, duplicated across sources, cancelled, or changed after collection.
Refresh is append-only: records are retained. Events no longer present in a refreshed source and past events are marked archived instead of deleted.
Confirm event date, cost, registration, accessibility, and age requirements with the organizer before attending.
